title: The Amphibious Leviathan
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the outside wall of the weathered stone lighthouse tower on its cliff, with iron rungs, ledges and wet masonry, waves exploding on the rocks far below. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): an enormous barnacled mechanical crab walker with glowing green conduits, iron claws, hissing hydraulic pistons and seaweed hanging from its armoured shell.
Camera: low-angle from the rocks looking up as the walker climbs; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: An enormous barnacled mechanical crab walker heaves itself out of the surf and climbs the cliff toward the lighthouse, iron claws biting into the rock, green conduits glowing, pistons hissing, seawater cascading off its shell.
No dialogue.
Sound: crashing surf, grinding metal, hydraulic hiss, rock cracking, deep mechanical groan.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
